analysis_limits: Static instruction counts are not dynamic work, throughput, or elapsed time.
The timed envelope includes clock-wrapper success/failure handling; it is broader than hot loops.
LLVM remarks without debug locations are function-level evidence, not a unique source-loop attribution.
Original AOT runtime archives are linked separately; this is not LTO.
No new Aevix SCEV, LVI, or KnownBits integration is asserted.
Parallel workers retain an indirect callback per element in the frozen runtime object.
Configured worker count does not prove actual successful thread starts during fallback.
